name: state
meaning: BulletState: 1 homing flight, 2 hit (attached to Ralph, playing anim 4), 3 final anim 1 then gone, 5 dormant/hidden. Set by Bullet_SetState 0x49e6c6 (0x49e6d5) and read by Update 0x49e167

name: elmer
meaning: Elmer (class 90), found by Scenaric_FindByClass(0x5a, &elmer, 1) in PostLoadInit 0x49e036; told msg 0x6f when the bullet lands (0x49e909)

name: swirlSign
meaning: SwirlSign (class 89), found by Scenaric_FindByClass(0x59, &swirlSign, 1) in PostLoadInit 0x49e04c; never read by this class

name: yawOffset
meaning: bearing of the bullet from Ralph relative to Ralph's own facing, computed when state 2 is entered (0x49e86d); the bullet is then held at 0x5a units on that bearing while he turns (0x49e2b9)

name: dist
meaning: XZ distance to Ralph measured every frame of state 1 (0x49e1f8); divides the 1000 u/s flight velocity in Bullet_AimAt (0x49e580)
